name: Desktop Browser Access Dialog
description: Owns explicit process-lifetime loopback and trusted-local-network Browser access controls without exposing capability links to renderer state.

states: Inspect the stopped state, local-only primary action, and the full-control HTTP warning before enabling local-network preview.
Inspect the active trusted-LAN state with one loopback address, multiple private IPv4 addresses, per-address copy actions, revocation, and both shipped locales.

useWhen: The Desktop process must explicitly start, inspect, switch, or revoke process-lifetime Browser access.
A trusted local network needs an HTTP preview link with full terminal control and an explicit warning.
avoidWhen: A Browser-connected Gateway page is already consuming access and must not gain listener lifecycle authority.
Internet exposure, TLS, account authentication, public IP publication, or a background service is required.
invariants: Browser access begins stopped and loopback is the default start mode; local-network binding requires an explicit user action.
The dialog receives only sanitized origins and bounded failure codes, never a capability fragment or complete access URL.
Capability copy and system-Browser open effects remain Main-owned and are available only for active exact origins.
Local-network preview always presents the HTTP and full-terminal-control warning and offers immediate revocation.
